name: Build a production-ready WhatsApp AI agent with OpenAI and Data Tables

parameters.content:
## Build a production-ready WhatsApp AI agent with OpenAI and Data Tables

### How it works

This workflow builds a production-ready WhatsApp AI assistant that receives customer messages, normalizes text and supported media, stores conversation history, and replies using an OpenAI-powered agent. It creates and uses n8n Data Tables for persistent memory, FAQ lookup, duplicate-message handling, buffering, and answer tracking. The workflow also handles media transcription/description/PDF extraction, sends WhatsApp replies, and can notify the owner via Telegram when escalation or errors occur.

### Setup steps

- Run the manual setup branch once to create the conversation and FAQ Data Tables.
- Configure WhatsApp Cloud API credentials and webhook settings for the trigger and WhatsApp send/media nodes. Use a permanent System User token, because test tokens expire after 24 hours.
- Configure OpenAI credentials for the chat model, voice transcription, and image description nodes.
- Populate the Business FAQ Data Table with the questions, answers, and business knowledge the agent should use.
- Update the Configuration node with the business name, assistant name, business information, and message buffer timing.
- The read/typing HTTP request node uses the same WhatsApp API credential. The phone number ID is read from each incoming message, so nothing else needs to be configured.
- Configure Telegram credentials and chat destination if owner alerts should be sent.

### Customization

Adjust the prompt-building logic, FAQ table contents, supported media branches, bufferSeconds value, fallback message, and owner-alert conditions to match the business tone, hours, escalation rules, and response length preferences.

## Create data tables

Manual setup branch that creates the persistent conversation table and FAQ table before the live WhatsApp agent is used.

## Receive and normalize message

Starts the live workflow from a WhatsApp webhook, applies business configuration, and converts the webhook payload into clean customer-message items.

## Deduplicate and log input

Checks whether incoming WhatsApp messages were already processed and records new inbound messages in the Data Table.

## Route message type

Branches the flow based on whether the incoming item is plain text or a supported media type that needs conversion.

## Fetch media file

Retrieves WhatsApp media metadata, checks whether the file type can be processed, downloads supported files, and creates explanatory text for skipped files.

## Convert media to text

Routes downloaded media to the right processor, transcribes voice notes, describes images, extracts PDF text, and standardizes the result as plain text.

## Buffer customer messages

Saves text content from plain messages or converted media, waits briefly for follow-up messages, fetches unanswered messages, and chooses which conversation should receive a reply.

## Send read indicators

Side branch that marks the WhatsApp message as read and displays a typing indicator while the agent prepares a response.

## Build conversation prompt

Loads saved conversation memory, assembles the agent prompt from history and current messages, and marks the batch of messages as answered.

## Run AI agent

Uses the OpenAI chat model and the Business FAQ Data Table tool to generate a contextual WhatsApp response or trigger fallback/escalation paths.

## Send successful reply

Formats the AI answer for WhatsApp, sends it to the customer, and stores the assistant response back into conversation memory.

## Fallback and escalation

Handles fallback customer messaging and owner notifications when the AI agent or WhatsApp sending path requires escalation.

parameters.text: Describe this image for a customer service assistant in 2 to 5 factual sentences. Read out any visible text exactly: product names, order or invoice numbers, prices, error messages, dates. If it shows a product, say what it is and its condition. Do not guess at anything you cannot see.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', status: 'read', message_id: $json.last_message_id, typing_indicator: { type: 'text' } }) }}

options.systemMessage:
=You are {{ $('Set Configuration Parameters').first().json.assistantName }}, the WhatsApp assistant for {{ $('Set Configuration Parameters').first().json.businessName }}.

About the business:
{{ $('Set Configuration Parameters').first().json.businessInfo }}

How to answer:
- For questions about products, prices, opening hours, delivery, returns or policies, call the Access Business FAQ tool first and only use what it returns. If the answer is not there, say you will check with the team. Never invent prices, dates, stock or policies.
- Write like a helpful person on WhatsApp: short, friendly, 1 to 4 short paragraphs, no headings or tables. Use *single asterisks* for bold only when it helps.
- Reply in the language the customer writes in.
- Text in [square brackets] describes a voice note, image, PDF, location or file the customer sent. Treat it as what the customer said or showed you.
- If several messages arrived together, answer them in one reply.
- If the customer asks for a person, is upset, or wants something you cannot do, say a team member will follow up.
- Today is {{ $now.toFormat('cccc, d LLLL yyyy') }}.

parameters.toolDescription: Returns the business FAQ as question and answer rows. Use it before answering any question about products, prices, opening hours, delivery, returns or policies.
